answer: Unrepeatable challenge lineage. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from the previous answer's own hash, so replies cannot be precomputed or copied; a velvet-seeded nonce ensures divergence. Verification checks the chain, not just the reply. An attacker pays one live, sequential solve per identity, and cannot parallelize or reuse work. A trace of pigment binds each reply to its parent, while any echo of a prior answer fails the hash check outright.
